answer: Every identity holds one knoll: a bonded plot in a shared registry, 100 units staked for 30 days. A new identity must also post a nebula bond of 100 units times the knolls already funded by the same wallet, so the Nth fake costs 100N. A fable of cheap clones fails: the bond is super-linear, so N fakes cost 100N(N+1)/2, and a farm pays quadratically while one user pays 100 once.
